description: This power represents distinct geographic anomalies and landmarks: geothermal geysers and mineral terraces, titanic meteor impact craters ringed with star-glass, hexagonal basalt column monoliths, vast blinding salt pans, and subterranean crystal caverns.
fantasticalDescription: This power represents fantastical cosmic wonders: singing quartz leylines humming with celestial harmonies, permanent aurora veils, tears in reality leaking arcane radiation, and anti-gravity anomalies.
examples: Geothermal Terraces, Meteor Craters, Hexagonal Basalt Columns, Expansive Salt Pans, Cavern Labyrinths, and Arcane Leyline Nexuses.
creativePrompts: What bizarre mineral or metaphysical properties make this landmark instantly recognizable from leagues away?
How does this feature alter the local climate, magnetic compasses, or weather patterns around it?
Will future civilizations revere this site as an altar of pilgrimage or avoid it as a cursed zone?
exampleNarratives: Steaming geothermal terraces cascaded into rainbow-hued mineral pools, hissing with volcanic vapor.
A star fell in primordial blinding fury, carving a five-league amphitheater ringed with fused silica tektites.
Thousands of geometric basalt pillars stepped out of the ocean surf like the abandoned causeway of giants.
